gloss: New Year's soup with rice cakes

definitions.gloss: New Year's soup with rice cakes
definitions.explanation: A traditional Japanese soup eaten on New Year's Day, made with mochi (rice cakes) and various vegetables and proteins in a broth. Recipes vary significantly by region and family.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{正月|しょうがつ}→お正月：05586_oshougatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{雑煮|ぞうに}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: We eat zōni on New Year's.

examples.english: The taste of zōni varies greatly by region — clear broth is standard in Kantō, while white miso is the norm in Kansai.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
{雑煮|ぞうに} is one of the most important dishes of the Japanese New Year (⟦{正月|しょうがつ}→正月：01433_shougatsu⟧). It is traditionally eaten on the morning of January 1st. The recipe is deeply tied to regional and family identity — asking someone about their {雑煮|ぞうに} is a common conversation topic.

Regional variations include:
- ⟦{関東|かんとう}→関東：00186_kantou⟧: clear broth (すまし{汁|じる}) with rectangular ⟦{餅|もち}→餅：03900_mochi⟧
- ⟦{関西|かんさい}→関西：00179_kansai⟧: ⟦{白|しろ}→白：13854_shiro⟧みそ broth with round ⟦{餅|もち}→餅：03900_mochi⟧

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {雑煮|ぞうに}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧ (to make zōni)
- {雑煮|ぞうに}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧ (to eat zōni)
- お{雑煮|ぞうに} (zōni — with polite prefix お)
